title: Inventory
name: Name
assetNote: Each unit received via goods receipt will get a unique asset ID (e.g. VGH-AST-00001) and a printable QR sticker.
photoFail: Stock movement recorded, but the optional photo could not be uploaded.
errNameUnit: Item name and unit are required
errStock: Stock values must be zero or greater
errQty: Select an item and enter a quantity greater than zero
emptyItems: No inventory items yet. Click "New Item" to add one.
typeHelp: Type can be changed only if item has no stock, transactions, or assets
receiptsToProcess: {{count}} goods receipt(s) waiting to inspect / post
gatePassesAwaiting: {{count}} gate pass(es) with no goods receipt yet
usedForHelp: Say where the material went: pick a phase or budget head, or enter a purpose.
reasonRequired: A reason is required for an adjustment.
errUsedFor: Choose a phase, a budget head or enter a purpose
returnHelp: Unused material going back to the store. Valued at the current average rate.
receiveIntro: Use this for stock that did not come through a purchase order. Stock POs (any payment type) are received through Gate Pass and Goods Receipt.
autoPostHint: You are a head/admin, so this will update stock immediately.
pendingHint: This will go to a project head or admin for approval before stock is updated.
errLines: Add at least one item with a name, unit and quantity greater than zero
mergeHelp: These items look like the same material under different spellings. Pick the one to keep; the other is folded into it (stock, history and assets move across) and future receipts with its name land on the kept item.
mergeConfirm: Merge "{{from}}" into "{{to}}"? This cannot be undone.
siteIntro: Morning: record what you took from the store. Evening: how much was used and how much came back. Used stays deducted; returned goes back into stock.
siteOverdue_one: {{count}} slip from an earlier day still needs its evening update. Pick that date to update it.
siteOverdue_other: {{count}} slips from earlier days still need their evening update. Pick those dates to update them.
siteNothing: No material taken to site on this day yet.
siteTakeHelp: Stock goes down as soon as you save. In the evening, enter how much was used and how much you returned.
siteEveningHelp: Enter how much was used. The rest is returned to stock automatically (you can change it). Used + returned must equal what was taken.
siteCloseDone: Slip {{n}} updated. Returned material is back in stock.
siteErrPick: Pick a material on every line.
siteErrQty: Enter a quantity above 0 on every line.
historyIntro: How much of each material was taken, used and returned on each day.
historyEmpty: No material was taken to site in these days.
sitePurposeHelp: Say what the material is for: a phase, a budget head or the work.
siteErrPurpose: Choose a phase, a budget head or enter the work.
siteCorrectHelp: Change used / returned if a wrong number was saved. More returned goes back into stock; less is taken out of stock again.
